name: Horizon Forbidden West
native_kbm_note: PS4/PS5 version is not playable with keyboard+mouse; the game ignores KBM and asks for a controller (windowsreport.com/horizon-forbidden-west-keyboard-and-mouse, gamepur).
notes: PC defaults from vulkk's 'KBM Default' column (some defaults changed in patches: TAB used to open the map before 1.1.47, weapon wheel is F by default). On-foot light melee key on PC is not explicitly listed; assumed MOUSE1 (as in HZD), so MOUSE1 is mapped to R2 (primary fire while aiming; heavy melee when not aiming). Light melee / weapon technique (R1) goes on MOUSE3, which is the PC weapon-technique key while aiming. G (PC heavy melee) also sends R2. LSHIFT = sprint (L3); PC also uses LSHIFT for Concentration while aiming (R3 on PS5) and mount speed-up (CROSS), not reproduced. E = use/pullcaster (TRIANGLE); PC also uses E to mount, which is SQUARE on PS5. SPACE = jump/grapple/swim up (CROSS); PC also uses SPACE for Shieldwing in air (SQUARE) and Valor Surge in wheel (R1), not reproduced. C = crouch/quick swap target/swim down (SQUARE). R = tool use / hold Hunter's Kit (DPAD_DOWN). Show HUD (PC H) is a touchpad swipe on PS5, omitted. Weapon slots 1-6, wheel scroll and walk (LALT) have no PS5 equivalent.
